We are creating devices that enable a bi-directional interface with the brain. These devices allow us to restore movement to the paralyzed, restore sight to the blind, and revolutionize how humans interact with their digital world.

Team Description: 

Operating out of our Fremont cleanroom facility, the Microfabrication group fabricates thin-film polymer electrode arrays (termed "threads") integral to Neuralink implants. Our team executes the complete internal process flow, spanning photolithography, thin-film deposition, etching, polyimide processing, electroplating, metrology, and final release. Collaborating closely with process engineering, quality, and implant assembly teams, we support the ramp from initial development runs to clinical and eventually commercial manufacturing scale. The equipment engineering group directly maintains total tool availability, capability, and qualification across the cleanroom to ensure continuous high-yield array output and rapid iteration.

Job Description and Responsibilities:

• Maintain continuous operational readiness and uptime for microfabrication equipment, including photolithography steppers, PVD systems, PECVD, plasma etchers, track coaters, electroplating units, and metrology tools.

• Perform root-cause diagnostics and repairs across electrical, mechanical, vacuum, pneumatic, RF, and control systems, implementing corrective actions to prevent recurrent failures.

• Establish and execute preventive maintenance protocols, covering chamber cleans, component replacements, seasoning routines, and post-maintenance hardware requalifications.

• Lead installation, facility integration, qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ), and formal release of new processing equipment, as well as deinstallations or equipment relocations.

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE.
